profile_text.body:
Stack AI is a software company that provides a no-code platform for building and deploying AI agents within enterprise environments. The platform uses a drag-and-drop interface and connects to more than 300 enterprise integrations, allowing AI agents to read, write, and execute tasks inside existing business systems. The company describes itself as supporting AI transformation across a variety of industries, including regulated sectors such as banking and education.

Stack AI's core product is its no-code AI application builder, which the site positions for enterprise-scale deployment with an emphasis on security, compliance, workflow automation, and data connector governance. Customer testimonials on the site reference use cases including agentic AI across corporate departmental functions, AI assistants for students built without coding, and production-ready AI systems in regulated environments.

The held facts list Stack AI under the Coding and Developer Tools category and confirm the company maintains a profile on theworldofai.org. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded at this time.
